parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift`. These are test-local mock session helpers whose structural similarity is incidental to their test-fixture role. Additionally, the `responses` field differs in a semantically meaningful way (`[Data]` vs `[String: Data]`), reflecting the distinct stubbing needs of each test suite. Lifting these into a shared PAT would couple test infrastructure across the `Artwork` and `Metadata` packages without a clear production benefit.
